# Site index models included in the package



```{r results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
reg <- CanadaForestAllometry:::si_model_registry_species() |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rank), model_id)

reg_fun <- reg |>
  dplyr::group_by(engine) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rank = max(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    description = paste(unique(description), collapse = "; "),
    reference = paste(unique(reference), collapse = "; "),
    province_scope = list(sort(unique(unlist(province_scope)))),
    species = list(sort(unique(unlist(species)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rank), engine)

bullets <- reg_fun |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    coverage = vapply(
      province_scope,
      function(x) {
        if (any(x == "ALL")) {
          "Canada (all provinces/territories)"
        } else {
          paste(x, collapse = ", ")
        }
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    species_cov = vapply(
      species,
      function(x) {
        if (length(x) == 0L) {
          "unknown"
        } else {
          paste0(length(x), " species (", paste(x, collapse = ", "), ")")
        }
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    bullet = paste0(
      "- `", engine, "()`",
      ". ", description,
      ". Coverage: ", coverage,
      ". Species coverage: ", species_cov,
      ". Reference: ", reference, "."
    )
  )

cat(paste(bullets$bullet, collapse = "\n"))
```
